**Scheduling & Staffing Support**

* Support the scheduling of tax professionals across multiple industries within the India Tax team.

* Monitor resource availability, capacity, PTO, training, and other scheduling commitments.
* Identify potential scheduling conflicts, capacity constraints, or workload imbalances and communicate findings to the Manager, Talent Optimization.

Resource Coordination
  
  
Relationship Management
  
  
Schedule Management
  
  
Problem Solving
  
  
Capacity Planning & Tracking
  
  
Business Acumen
  
  
Workforce Analytics
  
  
Time Management
  
  
Operational Support
  
  
Attention to Detail
  
  
Data Accuracy & Reporting
  
  
Adaptability

title: Junior HR Intern
description:
Curd Rice is a strategy consulting studio in Coimbatore. We help founders of ₹1–100 Cr businesses across India, the Gulf and Asia scale without chaos, and we build BIOS, our own AI-powered business intelligence platform. We are small, fast and growing, which is why we need you.

Role: Junior HR Intern Location: On-site, R S Puram, Coimbatore Duration: 6 months, full-time 

What you will own

You will run hiring and people operations for a growing firm:

* Write and post job descriptions on LinkedIn, Naukri, Internshala and college placement cells
* Screen resumes against a scoring rubric and shortlist candidates
* Schedule interviews, coordinate with partners, and keep every candidate informed
* Maintain the hiring tracker and employee records
* Prepare offer letters, appointment letters and onboarding checklists

There is no HR department here. You will be the first person doing this full-time, so you will build processes, not follow them. Partners are busy; you will need to chase decisions politely and persistently.

Apply here with your resume and a 150-word note on why HR, and why a small firm. Applications without the note will not be reviewed.

Requirements

Must have

* Pursuing or completed MBA/PGDM (HR), MSW (HRM), or BBA/BCom with an HR elective
* Clear, error-free professional English and comfortable spoken Tamil
* Working knowledge of Google Sheets or Excel (sorting, filters, basic formulas)
* Available on-site in Coimbatore for 6 months

Good to have

* Prior HR internship, campus placement committee role, or event recruitment experience
* Experience with any job board or ATS (Naukri RMS, Zoho Recruit, LinkedIn Recruiter)
* Basic knowledge of PF, ESI or the Tamil Nadu Shops & Establishments Act

Benefits

* Monthly stipend Based on Performance
* Direct mentorship from a founding partner
* Real ownership: your work becomes Curd Rice's HR system
* Exposure to strategy consulting across D2C, retail and manufacturing clients
* Internship certificate and recommendation letter
* Pre-placement offer for strong performers

The Eye Foundation is a leading eye specialty hospital network in South India with nearly three decades of experience in delivering advanced eye care. description:
Are you a people\-centric HR professional who enjoys partnering with business leaders, driving employee engagement, and creating a high\-performance culture?
 



  





**Location:** 
 Coimbatore
 *(Open for Chennai)* 




**Qualification:** 
 Full\-Time MBA (Mandatory)
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Partner with business leaders to translate business priorities into effective people strategies.
* Act as a trusted advisor on employee lifecycle management, organizational culture, and workforce planning.
* Drive employee engagement, recognition, and retention initiatives that enhance employee experience.
* Coach managers on talent management, performance management, leadership effectiveness, and organizational change.
* Manage employee relations, grievance handling, and conflict resolution while ensuring a positive work environment.
* Ensure compliance with HR policies, labor laws, and data protection standards.
* Leverage HR metrics and insights to support data\-driven decision\-making.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders in a matrixed environment to address workforce needs.
* Support onboarding, performance reviews, exits, leadership development, and transformation initiatives.
* Prepare HR dashboards, reports, and presentations for business leaders and key stakeholders.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 ✔ 8\+ years of progressive HRBP experience
 



 ✔ Strong stakeholder management and business partnering skills
 



 ✔ Experience supporting dynamic and fast\-paced business environments
 



 ✔ Strong knowledge of employee relations and HR compliance
 



 ✔ Excellent communication, influencing, and analytical skills
 



 ✔ Full\-Time MBA (Mandatory)
